# Statistical diagnostics and narrative text generation for parish-level
# impact distributions (skewness, IQR, max-to-median ratios) across all
# 15 flood scenarios.

## Setup
```{r}
source(here::here("Code/utils/loading_utils.R"))
source(here::here("Code/utils/impact_utils.R"))
source(here::here("Code/utils/export_utils.R"))
source(here::here("Code/00_scenario_definitions.R"))

load_processed_data()
```

## 1. Parish Impact Aggregation (All 15 Scenarios)
```{r}
# Load flood scenarios and subtract baseline.
x_delta_all_supp  <- load_flood_scenarios(type = "all") - base_tt_all
x_delta_hosp_supp <- load_flood_scenarios(type = "hosp") - base_tt_hosp

# Compute parish-level impact (population-weighted mean).
df_impact_all  <- compute_parish_impact(x_delta_all_supp, Worldpop_density, Parish_boundaries)
df_impact_hosp <- compute_parish_impact(x_delta_hosp_supp, Worldpop_density, Parish_boundaries)
```

## 2. Statistical Diagnostics
```{r}
# Computes distributional statistics across parishes for each scenario
compute_diagnostics_local <- function(df, prefix) {
  cols <- grep("^Average_Weighted_Delta_TT_", names(df), value = TRUE)
  purrr::map_dfr(cols, function(col) {
    x <- df[[col]]
    tibble::tibble(
      Scenario       = sub("Average_Weighted_Delta_TT_", "", col),
      Mean           = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
      Median         = median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
      IQR            = IQR(x, na.rm = TRUE),
      Max            = max(x, na.rm = TRUE),
      Max_Med_Ratio  = max(x, na.rm = TRUE) / median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  }) %>% mutate(FacilityType = prefix)
}

diag_all  <- compute_diagnostics_local(df_impact_all, "All Facilities")
diag_hosp <- compute_diagnostics_local(df_impact_hosp, "Hospitals")

diag_combined <- bind_rows(diag_all, diag_hosp)

knitr::kable(diag_combined, digits = 2, caption = "Scenario Diagnostics (96 Parishes)")
```

## 3. Narrative Generation
```{r}
# Generates human-readable summary statements per scenario × facility type
make_narrative <- function(diag_df) {
  diag_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(statement = paste0(
      "In ", FacilityType, ", the maximum parish increase is ", round(Max, 1),
      " min under ", Scenario, ", compared with a median of ", round(Median, 1), " min."
    )) %>%
    dplyr::pull(statement)
}

narratives <- make_narrative(diag_combined)
cat(paste(narratives, collapse = "\n\n"))

writeLines(narratives, here::here("Manuscripts", "narrative_segments.txt"))
```
